mai: quick heads-up — harbor-v3 (q4a-pack) shows a weird ZWJ-driven punctuation cling when mixing Simplified Chinese and Arabic, causing quotes/brackets to attach to the wrong side. small repro and numbers below.
omar: paste input + both detoks + tokenizer/pack config pls
mai: tokenizer=hybrid-unified-2030, pack=q4a-pack. repro: CJK + Arabic + ZWJ around punctuation.
```
input: 我在看到了新品: "3047484440‍ 33?"
# visible: 我在看到了新品: "ذهول‍س?"
expected (fp16) detok: 我在看到了新品: "ذهول س?"
q4a detok: 我在看到了新品": 3047‍4844
# note: double quote moved and colon separated from CJK span; ZWJ sequence seems to make alias punctuation cling to RTL run
```

zara: odd. can you run tokenizer.verbose_tokens and dump token ids for fp16 vs q4a for that example? specifically check any alias for U+0022 (quote) or U+FF1A (fullwidth colon) and whether ZWJ (U+200D) gets packed into neighbor tokens.

kevin: also check streaming detok path — incremental reconcilers treat ZWJ combos differently. if packer creates alias tokens that include ZWJ, the bidi mirror table might be wrong.

omar: ran token-id diff. fp16 -> [120,3456,4002,77,900] ; q4a -> [120,3456,8209,77,900] where 8209 is pack-alias for U+0022 with ZWJ context.

omar: alias 8209 is treated as directionally-strong in bidi pass, causing it to bind to Arabic run and flip placement. probable root cause.

mai: eval snapshot: zh->ar BLEU harbor-v3 fp16 23.6, harbor-v3 q4a 19.8 (drop ~3.8). zh->en stable. run: https://redwood-internal/eval/3245-harbor-zwj

zara: experiments: (A) reencode without pack aliases on 1k mixed zwj examples, (B) patch bidi resolver to treat pack-alias tokens containing ZWJ as neutral, (C) tokenizer pre-normalize to remove ZWJ around punctuation before packing.

triage-bot: started triage/bisect/3245678901 on runner-6 — ETA ~14m. report will be posted to CI link.

kevin: if A recovers BLEU fully that's a smoking gun. short-term mitigation: pre-normalize or expand pack aliases for punctuation that include ZWJ so mirror semantics are preserved. long-term: packer should preserve ZWJ context in metadata and set mirror=neutral where appropriate. add unit tests for CJK+ZWJ+RTL combos and streaming vs batch detok.

triage-bot: update — job running (8m remaining).

mai: thanks — assigning ML ticket ML-5408 and will follow up with PR once triage summary lands. please make sure regression asserts include the failing sample set and streaming check. :thumbsup:
